=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Smoke-fixture projects never page" and "`tg_notify` and the project-scoped direct alerts (final-merge, project complete) skip those projects and log `TG_NOTIFY_SMOKE_SILENCED tracking_issue= level=`." (operator decision Q42: A)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh project-completion paths at line 13427 (`mark_validation_complete`) and line 25481 (validation-disabled completion path).
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds `if ! _smoke_fixture_alert_silenced "..."` guards at three direct `tg_send_msg` sites (line 12023 final-merge CRITICAL, line 20630 externally-merged, line 20729 judge-complete), and the test `test_poller_builds_the_smoke_set_once_and_guards_direct_project_alerts` pins the count to exactly 3 with `assert text.count('if ! _smoke_fixture_alert_silenced "') == 3`. But the orchestrator has four `MSG="Project #${TRACKING_NUM} completed..."` constructions (line 13422 in `mark_validation_complete`, line 20624 externally-merged, line 20723 judge-complete, line 25476 validation-disabled). Lines 13422 and 25476 are reached when a smoke fixture project actually completes the orchestrator pipeline (the test titles include decomposed `[Orchestrator] [E2E Orchestrate Smoke N] ...` projects that run the full pipeline), and their `tg_send_msg "${MSG}" "DEBUG"` calls fire without the smoke fixture guard. At default `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=DEBUG` (which the scheduled poller does inherit, unlike `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT` on release workflows), both paths send a Telegram notification for a fixture project. The PR description's stated scope ("three direct sends") and the test's hard count of 3 freeze this gap rather than catch it.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
